## PR assurance record
Add `reviews/PR-<number>.md` based on [the assurance-record template](../docs/PR_ASSURANCE_RECORD_TEMPLATE.md). The merge-evidence workflow validates that it is bound to the exact reviewed code snapshot.

## Merge authorization
- Confirm the active ruleset and required status checks.
- Resolve review threads.
- Obtain exact-head owner authorization using the configured mechanism.
- A changed head SHA requires fresh authorization.

## Review checklist
- [ ] The change is focused and project-agnostic.
- [ ] Complete diff reviewed.
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, private material, or unintended metadata.
- [ ] Dependencies, scripts, and workflows reviewed where relevant.
- [ ] Documentation and handover match implementation.
- [ ] Claims about tests, scans, settings, and controls are evidence-backed.
- [ ] No merge or release is implied by opening this PR.
